meta.name: generate-image
meta.description: Generate or edit images with AI models through the OpenRouter Image API (Gemini, Seedream, Recraft, GPT-Image, Riverflow). Use for photos, illustrations, artwork, concept art, visual assets, logos, and image editing or compositing from reference images. For flowcharts, circuits, pathways, and other technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文字描述生成图像,或基于参考图编辑合成新图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把文字想象变成图片素材,或对已有图片做编辑合成
copy.tagline_en: Generate images from text prompts, or edit and composite photos using reference images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn text descriptions into images or edit photos without design software.

howto.what: Claude 会用脚本调用 OpenRouter 的图像模型,根据你的文字描述生成图片,或修改已有图片,并把结果保存为 PNG 文件。
howto.when: 当你要求生成照片、插画、艺术图等通用图像,或要求修改已有图片时触发;技术图表归 scientific-schematics 管。

say.text: 画一张日落时分的山景
say.note: 生成图片并保存为 PNG

say.text: 把 photo.jpg 的天空改成紫色
say.note: 进入编辑模式修改原图

say.text: 生成一张 DNA 概念插画,存为 figure.png

howto.what_en: Claude will use a script to call OpenRouter image models, generating images from your text description or editing existing ones, then save the result as a PNG file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for photos, illustrations, artwork, or other general images, or request edits to an existing image; technical diagrams are handled by scientific-schematics instead.

say_en.text: Draw a mountain view at sunset
say_en.note: Generates an image and saves as PNG

say_en.text: Make the sky in photo.jpg purple
say_en.note: Enters edit mode to modify the image

say_en.text: Generate a DNA concept illustration, save as figure.png
say_en.note: Outputs image to the specified path
